preservation: v1/v1.1/v2 source, protocol, results and failures remain unchanged
scope: Finite synthetic stochastic latent-restoration mechanism, robust semantic evidence and executable native budget bridge. Not a natural-data foundation model or a general learned FBSDE solver.

feedback.conditioning: one-hot text encoder report from new clean rendered input; same eight concepts
feedback.initial_and_transition_innovations: three declared branches {-scale*d,0,+scale*d}; a separate public direction per depth; future branch is revealed only after REFINE
feedback.clean_anchor_can_bypass_restoration: Reported as a separate no-disturbance reference; this benchmark requires exogenous disturbance and cannot establish superiority over direct generation.
feedback.trainable_groups: conditional refiner only; source encoders, initial map and decoders frozen
feedback.ndu_objective: negative exact recursive risk-sensitive utility over the full current latent tree; external loss to encoded class, no auxiliary reconstruction anchor
feedback.matched_compute: both arms evaluate the same entire latent tree and same decoder examples for each of 30 updates; backward arithmetic and native/compiler cost reported separately
feedback.training_terminal_utility: negative unchanged v2 external output loss against the conditioning class; this isolates restoration, not unknown input truth
feedback.static_policy: fixed depth chosen by exact nominal noise expectation before heldout generation; penalty charged once per executed refinement
feedback.online_controller: STOP/REFINE selected again after each observed latent; immutable exact-node state binding, native session owns budget and emission seal
mechanism_gates: same conditioning and depth has both STOP and REFINE on actual differing latent histories
at least 5 percent and at most 95 percent of nominal heldout trajectories refine
utility-only refiner gradients finite and nonzero in at least half of registered NDU updates
independent Bellman parity and native/Python action parity
feedback.continuation_contrast: ndu_feedback minus ndu_myopic; superiority only if independently negative paired CI, otherwise unresolved
feedback.all_other_contrasts: descriptive; no multiplicity-adjusted general superiority claim

robust_sources.ambiguity: joint report likelihoods across registered source regimes, conditioned on available reports; history rectangular envelope used only where explicitly stated
robust_sources.generation: actual source checkpoint depth0 four decoders, portfolios from 331-point frozen grid
robust_sources.independent_verifier_contract: new, paid, separately rendered raw text observation; reveal only on chosen query; external verifier is an additional information assumption, not a recovery of hidden truth from old inputs
robust_sources.no_verifier_limit: in the explicitly uniform eight-class all-shared-wrong generator, observed report excludes one class and leaves seven exchangeable possible truths; best conditional top1 probability is 1/7

preference.model: Gaussian lottery CE=mean-gamma*variance/2; fixed logistic temperature and utility scale

fbsde.scope: known entropic Brownian analytic special case with separate U and Z and numerical residual check

infrastructure.native: actual compiled codex-hepta-ndu budget/feedback bridge, not production NeuronRuntime deployment
infrastructure.execution: local CPU completion and external Actions assignment are distinct gates

evidence_rules: no thresholds changed after heldout inspection
all offline model forwards and tree compilation counted
